title: OperatorFee
description: The operator's per-payment infrastructure charge (ADR-021), realized as one balanced leg of the PaymentIntent fulfilment posting (ADR-011). The AMOUNT is resolved by the operator's Pricing Engine — the protocol stores only the resolved minor-unit result + the references that produced it, never a rule or a percentage. INTERNAL: never returned by a public API, never shown to a payer.

payment_intent_id.description: The fulfilled PaymentIntent (ADR-014) this fee was charged on.

posting_id.description: The ledger posting (ADR-011) whose balanced legs include this fee. Append-only.

amount_minor.description: Resolved fee in integer minor units. Never float. May be 0 (e.g. GOVERNMENT / unpriced category).

fee_policy_ref.description: The opaque policy ref used (FeePolicyRef.ref), for audit only.

irreversible.description: Always true: corrected only by a reversal posting, never by mutation.

_numeric_domain: Integers in a signed or digested BANZA artifact are bounded by the canonicalization in force (BCJ/1: |n| <= 2^53-1, spec/canonicalization.md P2). The bound is declared here so the schema and the canonicalization cannot disagree about what is representable.
